article.title: It's National Hat Day!
article.author: Hattie Cone
article.featured_img_alt: An ice cream server wearing a fun hat
article.content:
National Hat Day is here, and our scoop team is celebrating in style.

Wear your funniest, fanciest, or most creative hat into the shop today and receive a free topping with any cone or cup. Our staff will choose a favorite at the end of the evening.

We cannot wait to see what you wear. Please keep hats family-friendly and smaller than the front door!
